WITH member_major AS (
  SELECT 
    major.college,
    COUNT(*) as group_count
  FROM member
  INNER JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
  GROUP BY major.college
),
stats AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(group_count) as total_count,
    AVG(group_count) as avg_count
  FROM member_major
)
SELECT 
  mm.college,
  mm.group_count,
  CAST(mm.group_count AS REAL) / s.total_count as ratio,
  mm.group_count - s.avg_count as difference
FROM member_major mm
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE s.total_count IS NOT NULL 
  AND s.avg_count IS NOT NULL 
  AND mm.group_count > s.avg_count
ORDER BY mm.college
